Fact.Description: #77: Schedule 2 line 1z (excess advance premium tax credit repayment, the only Part I line 1 item in scope). Form 6251 line 10 adds "Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 1z".

Fact.Name: Schedule 2 line 6: Net investment income tax
Fact.Description: #83. Schedule 2 (Form 1040) 2026 draft (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040s2--dft.pdf, form page 1 = PDF p. 2), Part II Section A, line 6: "Net investment income tax. Attach Form 8960". (Line 12 on the 2026 draft is "Section 965 net tax liability installment from Form 965-A"; the NIIT line is 6.) i8960 (2026 draft) p. 22, Line 17: "If you file Form 1040 or 1040-SR, include this amount on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 6." f8960 (2026 draft) line 17: "Enter here and include on your tax return". Line 6 is in line 15 ("Add lines 4 through 11 and line 14"), which flows to line 21 ("Add lines 15 and 20. These are your total additional taxes. Enter here and on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 23"), taxCalculations /line21OfSchedule2.

Fact.Name: Schedule 2 line 11: Additional Medicare Tax on self-employment income
Fact.Description: #82. Schedule 2 (Form 1040) 2026 draft (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040s2--dft.pdf) line 11: "Additional Medicare Tax on self-employment income. Attach Form 8959". f8959 (2026) line 18: "Enter here and on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 11". Line 11 is in Part I Section A (line 15 = lines 4 through 11 and 14), which flows to line 21 and Form 1040 line 23 (taxCalculations /line21OfSchedule2).

Fact.Name: Schedule 2 line 17b: Additional Medicare tax on Medicare wages and RRTA compensation
Fact.Description: #82. Schedule 2 (Form 1040) 2026 draft line 17b: "Additional Medicare tax on Medicare wages and RRTA compensation. Attach Form 8959". f8959 (2026) line 12: "Also enter this amount on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 17b". Line 17b is in line 17d, then line 20, then line 21 ("Add lines 15 and 20. These are your total additional taxes. Enter here and on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 23").
#77: Schedule 2 line 2, alternative minimum tax. Form 6251 (2026) draft, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f6251--dft.pdf, line 11: "Enter here and on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 2".
Line 3 of schedule 2 for line 17 of form 1040. #77: line 3 = line 1z + line 2 (AMT).
